workarounds.symptom: A generation config loaded from the Hub can't be saved again
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Allow saving an unchanged generation config. Target files: src/transformers/generation/configuration_utils.py, tests/generation/test_configuration_utils.py. `GenerationConfig.save_pretrained` validates strictly and refuses to save if it finds any minor issue. Some Hub configs already contain one. For example, `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` sets `top_p=0.95` without `do_sample=True`, so loading it and saving it back raises. Saving a model also saves its generation config, so `model.save_pretrained()` writes `config.json` a... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49914)
